title: Kollar injectivity for Picard groups of punctured spectra under a depth condition

standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Local cohomology and normalized dualizing complexes, Matlis duality, depth/support inequalities, Hilbert–Samuel growth in dimension one, existence of a nonvanishing section on finitely many points of a quasi-affine scheme, and catenary S2 dimension theory. Coherent triples and their polynomial/positivity lemmas are retained local proof.

core_obligations: Encode a line bundle trivial modulo f as an invertible coherent triple, and use the retained Hilbert-triple and positivity arguments to obtain a nonnegative polynomial detecting its tensor powers.

Use local duality and the depth hypotheses to confine the obstruction module to one-dimensional support, then choose a section and derive a linear bound incompatible with nonzero even polynomial growth.

proof_roadmap.step: Encode a line bundle trivial modulo f as an invertible coherent triple, and use the retained Hilbert-triple and positivity arguments to obtain a nonnegative polynomial detecting its tensor powers.

Use local duality and the depth hypotheses to confine the obstruction module to one-dimensional support, then choose a section and derive a linear bound incompatible with nonzero even polynomial growth.

difficulty_reason: The argument combines a geometric line-bundle problem with polynomial growth and a controlled local-duality obstruction. Choosing a single section that converts all tensor powers into linear growth is a substantive H2 step after the declared local algebra, rather than a direct application of a Picard restriction theorem.
